label: Alfentanil PK — Maitre (1987)

extraction.tier_rationale: TRAP 1 (human item): the abstract states a coefficient of variation; curated as an exact log-normal CV, omega2 = ln(1+CV^2). The 33% CV on Vc is NOT curated: Hypnos samples BSV in volume/clearance space, but Maitre's eta on Vc keeps the micro-rate constants fixed, so sampling it here would wrongly move k12/k13. That band is therefore a lower bound.

parameters.label: rate constant 2->1
parameters.covariate_model: k21 = 0.0673 (Raemer 1990 prints 0.673, a 10x misprint; every implementation and the usual quotation use 0.0673)

parameters.label: effect-site equilibration rate constant
parameters.covariate_model: ke0 = ln2 / 0.9 min = 0.77 (EEG t1/2 ke0, Scott & Stanski)

extraction.source_locator: simtiva: 'ke0 derived from Scott & Stanski'; opentiva: ke0 0.77

predictive_performance.population: prospective computer-controlled infusion, arterial, n=40 (Raemer 1990 groups 1+2A; measured exceeded target in 94% of samples)
prospective computer-controlled infusion, arterial, n=40 (Raemer 1990 groups 1+2A)

extraction.tier_rationale: Population (NONMEM) model from 45 patients in four studies, with weight and sex on Vc and age on CL and k31. Prospectively it under-predicted badly (MDPE +53%, Raemer 1990), which is why it is Tier C despite its population pedigree. The envelope (age 25-53, weight 41-95 kg) is taken from the opentiva implementation, not the paper (a human item).

source_review.reviewed_by: automated source cross-check (Claude Opus 5.5 via Hypnos)
source_review.method: compared against the primary abstract, a page-image transcription of the reprinted parameter table (Raemer 1990 Table 1), and three open implementations
sources: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/3099604/ (abstract: CL 0.356 L/min and Vc 7.77 L for a 70-kg male < 40 y; CV 48% CL, 33% Vc)
https://github.com/StevenLShafer/stanpumpR (papers/digests/PMID_2360742.md: Raemer 1990 Tables 1-3 transcribed from rendered page images)
https://github.com/luktinghin/simtiva (pharmacology.js, Maitre: vc 0.111*mass, x1.15 female; k21 0.0673; ke0 ln2/0.9)
source_review.notes: All structural values agree across the abstract, Raemer's reprint and simtiva. Two discrepancies, both resolved by the sources, never silently: (1) opentiva codes V1 = 0.11*WGT (7.70 L), but the abstract's 7.77 L at 70 kg and Raemer's page image both give 0.111; 0.111 is curated. (2) Raemer prints k21 0.673, ten times the 0.0673 every implementation uses (a misprint; Maitre 1987 itself not read). ke0 0.77 = ln2/0.9 min is attributed to Scott & Stanski by simtiva and to Shafer & Varvel 1991 by opentiva. HUMAN ITEMS: read Maitre 1987 Table for k21 and the envelope; pin the ke0 source.

notes: Half of the alfentanil divergence pair. A population model from 1987 that prospectively under-predicted measured concentrations by about half (MDPE +53%), while the older two-stage Scott set was nearly unbiased (+1%) in the same pump study. Pedigree is not performance.
